definition: A packaged application and its dependencies provide the files needed to start a container.
A file, process, or network connection is required while the application runs.
A generated file or image is used to build or deploy the application.
A list identifies running applications that can be analyzed for containerization.
A separate compatible machine performs containerization and deployment for an application server.
A file contains the instructions used to build a container image.
A repository service stores container images for later deployment.
Containerization includes selected application files and dependencies for a supported framework.
Containerization includes all non-system files when dependency discovery needs a broader scope.
A collection of AWS resources is managed together using a CloudFormation template.
An automated sequence builds and deploys application updates.
A configuration file describes Kubernetes deployment resources for the containerized application.
